summary.text: Lee Anderson, a Republican, was first elected in 2016 to Georgia Senate District 24, and he chairs the Senate Natural Resources and the Environment Committee.

paragraphs.text: He served in the Georgia House of Representatives from 2009 to 2012 and was then appointed by Governor Deal to the Board of Corrections.
He attended Abraham Baldwin Agricultural College, is a native of Columbia County, and operates a farm on land his family has farmed since the early 1900s.
